judgeRationale.readability: The report is well structured and keeps claims separate from evidence boundaries, though it is dense for a 47.6-second source.
judgeRationale.knowledgePrioritization: The three-tool structure and the highest-risk corrections are prominent; a few low-level UI details receive nearly equal visual weight.
judgeRationale.evidenceUsefulness: Prompt text, UI states, three-source input count, audio windows, and provenance limits are directly actionable and traceable.
judgeRationale.executionValue: A reader can reproduce what to inspect and knows which steps, rights, and causal links are absent, but the video itself does not provide a complete runnable workflow.
judgeRationale.compressionWithoutLoss: The reconstruction preserves the decisive nuances without substantive omission; it could still compress repeated caveats and variant names.

metaAudit.rationale: The independent audit and current evidence jointly cover speech/SRT, burned captions, product cards and UI text, prompts and parameters, before/after visuals, editing order, non-speech audio semantics, presenter/gesture continuity, inserted assets/marks, and bounded absence evidence. They also guard the narration/UI three-versus-two-source conflict, combined-prompt semantics, edited chronology versus causal provenance, technical segmentation versus semantic continuity, opening-to-closing relation, and parallel-list versus pipeline structure. The candidate's own metaGate was not used as proof.
